claims.claim: Toyota Corolla 2010 engine and gear box 2ZR
claims.evidence: Witness photo shows several small used engines/motors, but make/model/engine code (2ZR) and gearbox details are not readable or confirmed.
No documentation, import papers, or engine/serial verification is shown in the witness report.
Witness report only describes engines laid out and wrapped; no running video, diagnostic printout, or sound/knock test evidence is included.
No mileage/odometer/usage records are shown or readable.
No seal/cover inspection evidence is provided in the witness report.

risks.risk: Wrong engine/gearbox fitment (2ZR vs another Toyota unit) or incompatible transmission/gearbox type
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the engine code/label (2ZR) and gearbox code/part number, plus the engine bay mounting/connector layout; ideally a video showing the exact engine/gearbox together.
risks.if_unproven: Price as unknown/possibly non-matching used engines/motors (worst-case fitment risk), with no guarantee of compatibility.

risks.risk: Not actually complete (missing starter/alternator/carburetor/injectors/ECU/wiring harness/hoses) or missing key accessories
risks.proof: A full inventory photo/clip of each unit laid out showing all major components, including starter, alternator, intake/exhaust manifolds, fuel system parts, ECU, wiring harness, and gearbox internals/hoses.
risks.if_unproven: Price as incomplete used engines/motors with unknown accessories.

risks.risk: Condition not proven (may not run, may have internal wear, low compression, or hidden damage)
risks.proof: Short running video (cold start if possible) and/or compression test results/diagnostic scan showing no misfires and stable readings.
risks.if_unproven: Price as non-verified working condition (worst-case: may require overhaul).

risks.risk: Quantity/selection mismatch (seller may be offering one specific Corolla engine+gearbox, but photos show multiple small engines/motors)
risks.proof: A clear count and identification of exactly which unit(s) are included, with labels or matching engine/gearbox codes for each.
risks.if_unproven: Price for the worst-case interpretation: multiple unspecified engines/motors rather than a guaranteed single Corolla 2ZR engine+gearbox set.

risks.risk: Fuel type/displacement uncertainty (petrol vs diesel, displacement differences) affecting value and conversion cost
risks.proof: Photo of engine specification plate/label showing fuel type and displacement, plus visible intake/fuel system configuration.
risks.if_unproven: Price as unknown fuel/displacement used engine(s).

risks.risk: Potential scam/overstatement (claims of testing/low mileage/Belgium origin not supported by verifiable evidence)
risks.proof: Proof of origin and testing: import documents (bill of lading/receipt), engine/gearbox serial numbers, and test/compression/scan reports.
risks.if_unproven: Price at a conservative level consistent with unverified claims and higher buyer risk.

proof_requests: Clear close-up photos of the engine code/label showing it is 2ZR (and any serial/engine number).
Clear close-up photos of the gearbox code/part number and confirmation it matches the Corolla 2010 2ZR setup.
A running video (start-up + idle) or compression test results/diagnostic scan showing no knock/misfire.
A complete parts inventory photo/clip for the exact unit(s) included (starter, alternator, ECU, wiring harness, fuel system parts, hoses, manifolds).
Photos showing the exact quantity included and which engine/gearbox pair you are selling (labels or matching codes).
Import/origin documentation to support “Tokunbo direct from Belgium” (receipt/bill of lading/engine number verification).
response.reason: The witness report confirms only that there are multiple small used engines/motors, but it does not verify the specific Corolla 2010 2ZR engine+gearbox claim, completeness, or working/testing status. Without at least the engine/gearbox identification and proof of condition, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set confidently.
